releaseNotes: HWM DEV 0.2.5.17 is the inventory-first update-management build. Service 0.2.5.12 reports detailed pending Windows Update inventory plus installed Microsoft 365 Apps, Edge, Chrome and Adobe Acrobat or Reader versions, channels and updater state. Tray 1.0.0.12 retains the long-idle ToolTip leak fix. This DEV build is inventory-only: no remote update installation actions are enabled yet.
